description: advanceProgress checks the lap before the gate in a different but equivalent shape
find:
if (progress.next === 0) return { lap: progress.lap + 1, next: 1 % n };
  return { lap: progress.lap, next: (progress.next + 1) % n };
replace:
const nextGate = (progress.next + 1) % n;
  return { lap: progress.lap + (progress.next === 0 ? 1 : 0), next: progress.next === 0 ? 1 % n : nextGate };
